novelty.justification: The claim asks whether a model internally represents “the adjustment mechanism rather than raw observational association,” specifically through an “adjusted-effect-beyond-observational” signal and a “confounder-in-vs-out sign-flip,” so its novelty route is a mechanism-specific measurement of causal adjustment rather than a new scientific setting. Searches around “TabPFN internal causal representation,” “backdoor adjustment activation probing,” “Simpson’s paradox mechanistic interpretability,” and “confounder activation steering” identify the closest work as “Does TabPFN Understand Causal Structures?” on decoding static causal graphs, alongside Physics Steering (2025) and Improving TabPFN’s Synthetic Data Generation by Integrating Causal Structure (2026); none of these supplied results tests a latent backdoor-adjustment representation through Simpson sign reversals. Moving from causal-graph decoding and generic concept steering to this adjustment-specific internal criterion is a non-trivial natural extension that combines established probing and steering tools with a newly operationalized causal quantity, but it does not introduce a fundamentally new interpretability paradigm.
